authority: PHASE2/concurrence/DESIGN.md v1.2 S2 (deterministic severity classifier, versioned in config, P2.1-style evidence-reviewable); VALIDATOR_GATE_DECISIONS_CP001_MAPPING_20260713 Decisions 2-3
load_bearing_rule: content-token overlap ratio of the claim against the king's canonical claim + final_synthesis; >= upper -> load_bearing true; <= lower -> false; ambiguous band -> load_bearing true (fail-closed per DESIGN S2)
critical_rule: CRITICAL iff the item attacks a load_bearing claim, evidence required by one, a dependency supporting one, or alleges a contradiction involving a load_bearing claim; unmapped objection -> CRITICAL (fail-closed)
issue_type_rule: contested_link/peer_cluster_id -> contradiction; challenge reason containing 'negation' -> logic; other challenge -> evidence-insufficiency; arbitration reason preserved verbatim in issue_type_source
notes: patch_sections_by_issue_type implements gate Decision 3 (disputed claim + linked evidence + dependent conclusions + affected confidence/uncertainty sections + dependent verdict); FINAL_SYNTHESIS and CLAIM are in scope whenever a dispute can change the verdict
